title: Describe accounting for stock appreciation rights

items.concept: Liability-classified SARs: subsequent measurement schedule (year-end FV × units × % service); period-end adjusting JEs including a reverse year; cash settlement at exercise
Number-variant twin: liability SARs subsequent measurement schedule; period-end adjusting JEs; cash settlement at exercise

Equity-classified SARs (employer may settle in stock): grant-date FV straight-line over service period; no FV remeasurement; settlement reclass to common stock/APIC; contrast if employer pays cash instead
Classification of SARs as liability vs equity based on cash-settlement feature
Subsequent measurement of liability SARs vs equity SARs
